<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1021
Claimant:
Dawn Lewis
Adjuster:
Chelsea Hebert
August 14, 2025
Claimant reported a left-turn collision at an intersection and states that the other vehicle, which was approaching from
the opposite direction, struck the driver's side. The driver is named on the policy, and the claimant is not represented
by an attorney.
August 21, 2025
Claimant reports a wrist fracture from the impact and was first seen at an urgent care facility. The reported injury is
consistent with a collision of this type.
August 27, 2025
Police report confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene. No independent eyewitness to the collision itself
has been identified so far.
August 29, 2025
Scene photographs were reviewed and confirm some of the described positions and points of impact. Vehicle
damage is largely consistent with the impact the claimant described.
October 2, 2025
Claimant gave the same account of how the collision happened in each conversation so far, including the direction of
travel and the sequence of events. No discrepancies have been noted.
November 12, 2025
Treatment has followed a typical course for this type of fracture, with follow-up visits spaced out as healing
progressed. Claimant reports steady improvement and fewer visits are now scheduled.
November 22, 2025
Medical history review found no earlier injury to the same wrist or arm. Claimant's records do not show prior treatment
for that area.
December 2, 2025
Vehicle history check found no prior damage to the claimant's car on file. Repair estimate was requested and is
pending review.
December 31, 2025
A neighbor contacted the office and believes the car already had damage some weeks before the claimed collision.
This statement has not been verified and will be followed up with the neighbor and with the repair shop.
February 5, 2026
Open items include the neighbor's statement, the final repair estimate, and the treating provider's discharge
summary. File will remain open until these items are reviewed.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
